experiment: Exact unique candidate coverage versus eligible entry coverage
selection: First 64 MS MARCO questions only; scalar thresholds selected for mean recall >= 0.96 and minimum fixed-budget replay latency
conclusion: No observed recall improvement from replacing entry fraction with exact unique fraction in this experiment; do not enable as production stopping policy
limitations: Previously inspected datasets and small query samples; exploratory, not independent certification
Transfer changes query type and codec
Replayed search latency excludes counting and progressive rereads; not an implemented adaptive latency result
Counter overhead is an alternating-order warm diagnostic comparison and remains timing-noisy
